Eigen — vendored headers
========================

Upstream:  https://gitlab.com/libeigen/eigen
Release:   3.4.0
License:   MPL-2.0 (see COPYING.MPL2), with some files under BSD-3-Clause
           (COPYING.BSD)

What is vendored
----------------
`Eigen/`, the header tree, verbatim from the 3.4.0 release tarball. Nothing is
patched, and this project has no `review.patch` for it.

`unsupported/`, `doc/`, `test/`, `demos/`, `bench/` and the build system are not
vendored: none of them is a header the compiler would reach.

The whole of `Eigen/` is here rather than a pruned subset for the same reason
`third_party/meshoptimizer` keeps its whole `src/`: the include closure is not
obvious from the outside. `Eigen/Geometry` alone pulls in SVD, LU, QR,
Householder and Cholesky, and a subset that compiles today breaks the next time
upstream reorganizes an include.

`EIGEN_MPL2_ONLY`
-----------------
Every build that includes these headers defines it (see
`crates/optimize/build.rs`). It makes Eigen refuse, at compile time, to
instantiate the few components that are not MPL-2.0 — so the licence of what
actually ends up in the binary is MPL-2.0 and BSD-3-Clause, and cannot silently
become anything else.

Who uses it
-----------
Only `third_party/instant-meshes` and the bridge that drives it
(`crates/optimize/src/remesh_bridge.cpp`). Nothing in the Rust workspace names
an Eigen type; the retopology output crosses into Rust as flat arrays.
